title: Double Drip 10K Pineapple Ice Prefilled Vape Pods + Refill
description: This Pod & Refill Pack is designed to pair with the Double Drip 10K Prefilled Pod Kit, providing a clean and easy way to extend the life of your device. Each pack includes a 2ml pod and 10ml refill bottle of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, offering up to 10,000 puffs of smooth, flavourful vapour (based on individual usage). Pineapple Ice blends the tropical juiciness of Pineapple with a crisp layer of cooling Menthol. Sweet yet sharp, this flavour delivers a bright, chilled vape that’s as refreshing as it is fruity. When you’re ready to switch flavours or refresh your kit, simply pop in the new pod and refill bottle and let the device’s auto-refill system take care of the rest—no mess, no fuss.
